import asyncio
import re
from playwright import async_api
from playwright.async_api import expect

async def run_test():
    pw = None
    browser = None
    context = None

    try:
        # Start a Playwright session in asynchronous mode
        pw = await async_api.async_playwright().start()

        # Launch a Chromium browser in headless mode with custom arguments
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                "--window-size=1280,720",
                "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
                "--ipc=host",
                "--single-process"
            ],
        )

        # Interact with the page elements to simulate user flow
        # -> navigate
        await page.goto("http://localhost:3002")
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        
        # -> Click the 'Agregar al carrito' button on the 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' product card.
        # Agregar al carrito button
        elem = page.get_by_role("button", name="Agregar Kubernetes Cluster")
        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Click the 'Agregar al carrito' button on the 'Kubernetes Cluster Overview' product card.
        # Carrito ( 0 ) link
        elem = page.get_by_role("link", name="Carrito, 1 artículos")
        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Click the 'Pagar con Stripe' button to start the checkout flow
        # Pagar con Stripe button
        elem = page.get_by_test_id("btn-pagar")
        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Fill the email and card fields (email, card number, expiration, CVC) and click the 'Pay' button to submit the payment.
        # email@example.com text field
        elem = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Email")
        await elem.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await elem.fill("buyer@example.com")
        
        # -> Fill the email and card fields (email, card number, expiration, CVC) and click the 'Pay' button to submit the payment.
        # Card number text field

        await elem.fill("12/34")

        await elem.fill("123")
        
        # -> Fill the email and card fields (email, card number, expiration, CVC) and click the 'Pay' button to submit the payment.
        # Pay Processing button

        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # -> Fill the 'Cardholder name' field with 'Buyer Example' and click the 'Pay' button.

        elem = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Cardholder name")
        await elem.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await elem.fill("Buyer Example")

        # Pay Processing button
        elem = page.get_by_test_id("hosted-payment-submit-button")
        await elem.click(timeout=10000)
        
        # --> Assertions to verify final state

asyncio.run(run_test())
